content:
TEMPTATION ||| Tilt my palm, letting the blade graze his skin ||| "Let them see how much this question stings."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, holding the blade firmly in my grip ||| "I won't answer until I know what’s really at stake."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, my heart racing in my chest ||| "I felt something shift between us when you drew that."  
REVERSAL ||| Turn the blade to face him, assert my stance ||| "I'm not just a pawn in your game anymore."  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, breath caught in my throat ||| *A deep breath, nothing more.*
